stems.label: City Ambience
stems.description: The low hum and crowd murmur of a bustling ancient city.
stems.prompt: A bustling ancient Roman city, distant crowd chatter and marketplace murmur, merchants calling out, general lively city ambience, warm and energetic

stems.label: Mournful Wind
stems.description: A desolate lonely wind blowing through ancient stone ruins.
stems.prompt: A desolate lonely wind blowing through ancient stone ruins, haunting and empty, low howling gusts, fine dust and ash skittering across cobblestones, eerie silence broken only by wind

stems.label: Volcanic Rumble
stems.description: Deep powerful continuous underground volcanic rumbling.
stems.prompt: Deep powerful continuous underground volcanic rumbling, low frequency earth tremors, ominous geological pressure building, distant subterranean booms, the earth itself groaning

stems.label: Ocean & Boats
stems.description: Mediterranean sea waves, splashing oars, creaking wooden boats.
stems.prompt: Gentle Mediterranean sea waves lapping against a shore, wooden oars splashing rhythmically in calm water, creaking of wooden boat hulls, oarlocks squeaking, peaceful yet urgent

stems.label: Panicked Crowd
stems.description: Large crowd in terror — screaming, shouting, desperate cries.
stems.prompt: A large crowd of people in extreme panic and terror, screaming and shouting desperately, cries of fear, gasps, chaotic mass panic, hundreds of voices overlapping in desperation

stems.label: Falling Debris
stems.description: Volcanic lapilli raining down on cobblestone streets and rooftops.
stems.prompt: Small volcanic rocks and debris raining down, percussive impacts on cobblestone streets, clattering against terracotta rooftops, constant pelting of small stones falling from the sky

stems.label: Fleeing SFX
stems.description: Mass exodus — footsteps, horse hooves, cart wheels, donkeys, harness.
stems.prompt: A mass exodus of people fleeing on cobblestone streets, dozens of heavy footsteps running, horse hooves clattering rhythmically on stone, wooden cart wheels rumbling and squeaking loudly, donkeys braying, leather harness jingling, urgent and chaotic

stems.label: Aftermath Wind
stems.description: Sad howling wind over desolate abandoned city after the eruption.
stems.prompt: A mournful howling wind sweeping through an abandoned desolate stone city, empty streets with wind gusting through stone corridors, faint distant clinking of pottery moved by the wind, haunting and sorrowful

stems.label: Eruption Roar
stems.description: Deafening volcanic eruption — explosive booms, lightning cracks, lava hiss.
stems.prompt: A massive volcanic eruption at full intensity, deafening explosive booms, thunderous cracks of volcanic lightning, the hiss and roar of lava, apocalyptic natural destruction, ear-splitting and overwhelming

stems.label: Pyroclastic Flow
stems.description: Immense pyroclastic surge — jet engine roar, buildings obliterated.
stems.prompt: An immense pyroclastic flow, a continuous jet-engine-like roaring and rushing sound, superheated gas and ash moving at tremendous speed, fire crackling, the cracking and splintering of thousands of buildings being obliterated, unstoppable force

stems.label: Final Desolation
stems.description: Vast empty wind over landscape completely buried in ash.
stems.prompt: A vast empty wind blowing across an enormous landscape completely buried under volcanic ash, immense desolate silence except for long mournful gusts, the sound of utter emptiness and death, low and haunting

stems.label: Survivor SFX
stems.description: Ash-covered survivors — shuffling footsteps, labored breathing, coughing.
stems.prompt: Ash-covered exhausted survivors slowly shuffling through debris, labored pained breathing, weak coughing, shuffling footsteps in deep ash, faint quiet sobbing, traumatized and shell-shocked people moving slowly

stems.label: Quiet Ambience
stems.description: Ancient ruins at dusk — gentle breeze, crickets, serene and timeless.
stems.prompt: Ancient stone ruins at dusk, peaceful and still, a gentle warm breeze, distant crickets beginning to chirp in the evening, serene timeless atmosphere, the quiet of history, soft and contemplative
